intro: Connects to the Geberit AquaClean Bridge for ESP over the ESPHome native API, locally and encrypted. The bridge needs the native API firmware; save an encryption key on its /setup page first.
host_help: Bridges found on the network are offered; e.g. aquaclean-xxxxxx.local
advanced_help: Discovery and diagnostic tools for other models, hidden by default on the bridge
cleanup: Remove states of functions the toilet doesn't offer
cleanup_help: After a rediscovery or a move to another toilet; Physical maintenance is always kept
